text_en: This is the lineage of Aaron and Moses at the time when the Lord spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
text_cn: 上主在西乃山上与梅瑟交谈的时候，亚郎和梅瑟的后裔如下：

text_en: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar;
text_cn: 亚郎儿子的名字是：长子纳达布、阿彼胡、厄肋阿匝尔和依塔玛尔：

text_en: these are the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, whom he ordained to minister as priests.
text_cn: 这是亚郎儿子的名字，他们都是受傅的司祭，受祝圣尽司祭之职。

text_en: Nadab and Abihu died before the Lord when they offered unholy fire before the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests in the lifetime of their father Aaron.
text_cn: 纳达布和阿彼胡在西乃旷野于上主面前献了凡火，立即死于上主面前，没有留下儿子；只有厄肋阿匝尔和依塔玛尔，在他们父亲亚郎面前执行司祭的职务。

text_en: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, so that they may assist him.
text_cn: “叫肋未支派前来，站在亚郎司祭面前，协助他服务。

text_en: They shall perform duties for him and for the whole congregation in front of the tent of meeting, doing service at the tabernacle;
text_cn: 他们应代亚郎和全会众，在会幕前尽应尽的义务，在会幕内服役，

text_en: they shall be in charge of all the furnishings of the tent of meeting, and attend to the duties for the Israelites as they do service at the tabernacle.
text_cn: 管理会幕内的一切器具，代以色列子民尽应尽之职，在会幕内服役。

text_en: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and his descendants; they are unreservedly given to him from among the Israelites.
text_cn: 你应将肋未人全交给亚郎和他的儿子，代以色列子民作亚郎的侍役；

text_en: But you shall make a register of Aaron and his descendants; it is they who shall attend to the priesthood, and any outsider who comes near shall be put to death.
text_cn: 你要委任亚郎和他的儿子执行司祭的职务；俗人擅自走近，应处死刑。”

text_en: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: I hereby accept the Levites from among the Israelites as substitutes for all the firstborn that open the womb among the Israelites. The Levites shall be mine,
text_cn: “看，我由以色列子民中拣选了肋未人，以代替以色列子民中一切头胎的长子，所以肋未人应归于我，

text_en: for all the firstborn are mine; when I killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated for my own all the firstborn in Israel, both human and animal; they shall be mine. I am the Lord .
text_cn: 因为凡首生的，都是我的；自我在埃及国击杀了一切首生之日起，凡以色列首生的，无论是人或是兽，都应祝圣归我，属于我：我是上主。”

text_en: Then the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying:
text_cn: 上主在西乃旷野训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Enroll the Levites by ancestral houses and by clans. You shall enroll every male from a month old and upward.
text_cn: “你应依照肋未人的宗族和家系，统计肋未的子孙，由一月以上，所有的男性都应登记。”

text_en: So Moses enrolled them according to the word of the Lord , as he was commanded.
text_cn: 于是梅瑟就照上主吩咐的命令，统计了他们。

text_en: The following were the sons of Levi, by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
text_cn: 肋未儿子的名字是：革尔雄、刻哈特和默辣黎。

text_en: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their clans: Libni and Shimei.
text_cn: 按族系，革尔雄儿子的名字是：里贝尼和史米。

text_en: The sons of Kohath by their clans: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
text_cn: 按族系，刻哈特的儿子是阿默兰和依兹哈尔，赫贝龙和乌齐耳。

text_en: The sons of Merari by their clans: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites, by their ancestral houses.
text_cn: 按族系，默辣黎的儿子是玛赫里和慕史：这些人按他们的家族都属肋未族系。

text_en: To Gershon belonged the clan of the Libnites and the clan of the Shimeites; these were the clans of the Gershonites.
text_cn: 里贝尼族和史米族出自革尔雄：这是革尔雄人的家族。

text_en: Their enrollment, counting all the males from a month old and upward, was seven thousand five hundred.
text_cn: 凡一月以上登记的男性，共计七千五百。

text_en: The clans of the Gershonites were to camp behind the tabernacle on the west,
text_cn: 革尔雄人的家族在会幕后面西方扎营；

text_en: with Eliasaph son of Lael as head of the ancestral house of the Gershonites.
text_cn: 革尔雄人的领袖，是拉耳的儿子厄里雅撒夫。

text_en: The responsibility of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting was to be the tabernacle, the tent with its covering, the screen for the entrance of the tent of meeting,
text_cn: 革尔雄的子孙在会幕内的职务，是照管帐幕、幕篷顶和会幕内的门帘，

text_en: the hangings of the court, the screen for the entrance of the court that is around the tabernacle and the altar, and its cords—all the service pertaining to these.
text_cn: 并庭院的帷幔，围绕帐幕与祭坛的庭院的门帘，以及庭院应用的一切绳索。

text_en: To Kohath belonged the clan of the Amramites, the clan of the Izharites, the clan of the Hebronites, and the clan of the Uzzielites; these are the clans of the Kohathites.
text_cn: 阿默兰族、依兹哈尔族、赫贝龙族和乌齐耳族出自刻哈特：这是刻哈特人的家族。

text_en: Counting all the males, from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred, attending to the duties of the sanctuary.
text_cn: 凡由一月以上登记的男性，共计八千六百；他们管理圣所。

text_en: The clans of the Kohathites were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle,
text_cn: 刻哈特子孙的家族在帐幕南边扎营。

text_en: with Elizaphan son of Uzziel as head of the ancestral house of the clans of the Kohathites.
text_cn: 刻哈特族的家族领袖，是乌齐耳的儿子厄里匝番。

text_en: Their responsibility was to be the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which the priests minister, and the screen—all the service pertaining to these.
text_cn: 他们的职务是管理约柜、桌子、灯台、两祭坛、圣所内应用的一切圣器、帷幔和为帷幔应尽的各种职务。

text_en: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest was to be chief over the leaders of the Levites, and to have oversight of those who had charge of the sanctuary.
text_cn: 亚郎大司祭的儿子厄肋阿匝尔是肋未人的最高领袖，监督在圣所服务的人。

text_en: To Merari belonged the clan of the Mahlites and the clan of the Mushites: these are the clans of Merari.
text_cn: 玛赫里族和慕史族出自默辣黎：这是默辣黎人的家族。

text_en: Their enrollment, counting all the males from a month old and upward, was six thousand two hundred.
text_cn: 凡一月以上登记的男性，共计六千二百。

text_en: The head of the ancestral house of the clans of Merari was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
text_cn: 默辣黎族的家族领袖，是阿彼海耳的儿子族黎耳。他们在会幕北边扎营。

text_en: The responsibility assigned to the sons of Merari was to be the frames of the tabernacle, the bars, the pillars, the bases, and all their accessories—all the service pertaining to these;
text_cn: 默辣黎的儿子的职务，是照管会幕的木板、横木、柱子、卯（mǎo）座，一切用具，并为会幕应尽的各种职务，

text_en: also the pillars of the court all around, with their bases and pegs and cords.
text_cn: 还管理庭院四周的柱子及其卯（mǎo）座、木桩及绳索。

text_en: Those who were to camp in front of the tabernacle on the east—in front of the tent of meeting toward the east—were Moses and Aaron and Aaron’s sons, having charge of the rites within the sanctuary, whatever had to be done for the Israelites; and any outsider who came near was to be put to death.
text_cn: 在会幕前面东方，即在会幕前朝日出的一面扎营的，是梅瑟和亚郎其他的儿子；他们代替以色列子民服务，管理圣所；俗人擅自走近，应处死刑。

text_en: The total enrollment of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron enrolled at the commandment of the Lord , by their clans, all the males from a month old and upward, was twenty-two thousand.
text_cn: 梅瑟和亚郎照上主的命令，统计了所有的肋未人，按家族凡一月以上的男性都统计了，共计二万二千人。

text_en: Then the Lord said to Moses: Enroll all the firstborn males of the Israelites, from a month old and upward, and count their names.
text_cn: 此后，上主又对梅瑟说：“以色列子民，凡一月以上首生的男性都要统计，登记他们的姓名；

text_en: But you shall accept the Levites for me—I am the Lord —as substitutes for all the firstborn among the Israelites, and the livestock of the Levites as substitutes for all the firstborn among the livestock of the Israelites.
text_cn: 应将肋未人献于我，我是上主，以代替以色列子民中所有的长子；又将肋未人的牲畜献于我，以代替以色列子民中一切头胎的牲畜。”

text_en: So Moses enrolled all the firstborn among the Israelites, as the Lord commanded him.
text_cn: 梅瑟便照上主所吩咐的，统计了以色列子民中所有的长子，

text_en: The total enrollment, all the firstborn males from a month old and upward, counting the number of names, was twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.
text_cn: 凡一月以上的头胎男儿，依名统计了，共计二万二千二百七十三人。

text_en: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Accept the Levites as substitutes for all the firstborn among the Israelites, and the livestock of the Levites as substitutes for their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am the Lord .
text_cn: “你要以肋未人替代以色列子民中所有的长子，以肋未人的牲畜替代他们的头胎牲畜；肋未人应属于我：我是上主。

text_en: As the price of redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the Israelites, over and above the number of the Levites,
text_cn: 至于那超过肋未人数目，而应赎回的二百七十三个以色列子民的长子，

text_en: you shall accept five shekels apiece, reckoning by the shekel of the sanctuary, a shekel of twenty gerahs.
text_cn: 为每一个，应照圣所的‘协刻耳’，征收五个‘协刻耳’，──一‘协刻耳’，合二十‘革辣’；──

text_en: Give to Aaron and his sons the money by which the excess number of them is redeemed.
text_cn: 将这钱交给亚郎和他的儿子，作为超额人数的赎价。”

text_en: So Moses took the redemption money from those who were over and above those redeemed by the Levites;
text_cn: 梅瑟就为那超过肋未人数而应赎回的人，征收了赎金。

text_en: from the firstborn of the Israelites he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, reckoned by the shekel of the sanctuary;
text_cn: 由以色列子民的长子所征收的银子，依圣所的“协刻耳”，共计一千三百六十五“协刻耳”。

text_en: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons, according to the word of the Lord , as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 梅瑟依照上主的命令，将这赎金交给了亚郎和他的儿子，全照上主吩咐梅瑟的。
